cues.onScreen: Title card: A retail outlet order, from paper PO to signed delivery note
1. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Signs in to the staff console with his work email
1. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: A one-time code is emailed to him, and he types it in
1. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: What's waiting: his work for today, each count opens the list behind it
2. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Enters Cool Planet's paper PO as a new outlet order
2. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Adds the lines: 120 Regular pads, 80 Panty liners, 60 Night pads
2. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Stock check: Regular pads and liners can go now. Night pads are out, so 60 wait, 6th in line
2. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Order SO-27-00047 is confirmed: 200 packs set aside, 60 back-ordered
3. Kasun Bandara, Stores: What's waiting: stock has arrived from production and is not yet received
3. Kasun Bandara, Stores: 2,400 Night pads arrived this morning, and outlets are waiting for them
3. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Checks the quantity and dates against the docket. The system gives the batch number
3. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Splits the batch: 1,440 packs for retail outlets, 960 for consultants
3. Kasun Bandara, Stores: The waiting outlets are listed, oldest order first
3. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Recorded. Outlet sales are alerted that outlets are waiting for Night pads
4. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Six orders wait for Night pads, oldest first. Cool Planet's new PO is 6th in line
4. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: He confirms with each outlet, then allocates from the top, starting with Fashion Park
4. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Each allocation sets the packs aside for that order, oldest first
4. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Last in line, Cool Planet's 60 Night pads on SO-27-00047
4. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Every waiting order now has its Night pads. Stores can pick them
5. Kasun Bandara, Stores: The dispatch board: outlet orders with stock set aside, oldest first
5. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Creates the pick list for SO-27-00047
5. Kasun Bandara, Stores: The pick list names the batch for each line, the earliest expiry first
5. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Packs by scanning each pack's barcode
5. Kasun Bandara, Stores: A full carton scans as 50 at a time
5. Kasun Bandara, Stores: A pack of wipes is not on this order, so the scan is refused
5. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Scans the right products until every line is packed
5. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Every item checked. The box is ready for its invoice and delivery note
6. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Packed and checked, so he can issue the invoice and delivery note
6. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Both are emailed to Cool Planet as PDFs and printed for the driver
6. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: The invoice: Cool Planet's PO number, trade prices, due date from its 45-day terms
6. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: The delivery note: quantities and batch numbers, no prices, and a box for the outlet to sign
7. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Records the vehicle and driver, then dispatches
7. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Out for delivery. The stock leaves the warehouse and the order waits for the signed note
8. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: The driver is back with Cool Planet's signed delivery note
8. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Uploads a photo of the signed note
8. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: The system reads the quantities from the note
8. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Figures read from the note are highlighted for him to check
8. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: Enters who signed for the goods, then confirms
8. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: All 260 packs received. The order moves to Completed
8. Ruwan Jayawardena, Outlet sales: SO-27-00047: every pack delivered, nothing outstanding
9. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Stock: one warehouse, with an allocation for each channel
9. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Night pads for outlets: the new batch, and what is still set aside for the other orders
9. Kasun Bandara, Stores: Batch B2702-06: when it was made, when it expires, where it is held
9. Kasun Bandara, Stores: It traces to Cool Planet's order SO-27-00047, ready for a recall list if ever needed
Title card: Cool Planet's order is complete
